dimensions.assessment: Affects the designated park area in Salem, Massachusetts, and federal park administration.
dimensions.evidence: Salem, Massachusetts, and its vicinity, and includes the Salem Armory Visitor Center building

dimensions.assessment: Changes the administrative designation name and mandates a study of potential park expansion.
dimensions.evidence: The Salem Maritime National Historic Site shall hereafter be known and designated as the 'Salem Maritime National Historical Park'.

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriation amount is stated in the text.
Redesignates an existing site in law and requires a localized boundary study.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary shall conduct a boundary study to evaluate the suitability and feasibility

dimensions.assessment: Permanent name redesignation paired with a boundary study report due within 3 years of funding availability.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 3 years after the date on which funds are made available... submit... a report

missing_information: Exact dollar amount made available to conduct the boundary study.
